question: Estimate the number of mobile cell towers in India (across all telcos).
idealClarificationQuestions: Total tower-sites (passive infra) shared by Jio + Airtel + Vi + BSNL? Yes.
Includes 4G + 5G + small cells (count separately)? Macro tower-sites primarily.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: TRAI BTS data + tower companies disclosures.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian tower companies (Indus Towers, ATC, Summit Digitel) operate ~7-8 lakh tower-sites combined.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus operator-owned (Jio's Jio Digital Infrastructure, BSNL towers): ~1.5-2 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: BTS (Base Transceiver Stations — radio cells, multiple per tower): ~25 lakh+ (4G+5G).
